en.topic_title: Hong Kong gov’t workers granted up to 12 hours of annual family care leave from January
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong government employees have been granted up to 12 hours of annual family care leave from January 2027 under a new initiative to promote family-friendly workplaces.



A caretaker walks with a little boy in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
